Use it when the card can move through the board without needing its own plan.

cards.title: DEMO · Bug — Mobile filter resets after refresh
cards.description:
A Bug records behavior that differs from the intended result.

Reproduce:
1. Select a board filter on mobile
2. Refresh the view
3. Observe the filter reset

Expected: the selected filter remains active.
Actual: the board returns to the default filter.

cards.title: DEMO · Feature — Save named board filters
cards.description:
A Feature adds a new operator capability.

Outcome: operators can save, select, rename, and remove reusable board filters.

This card is In progress to demonstrate an active feature lane.

cards.title: DEMO · Chore — Refresh README screenshots
